fusions.name: Barbed Twist
fusions.desc: Twists a thorn into a target already carrying one of your afflictions, using it up to deal 8 damage and leave the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bramble Snag
fusions.desc: Throws a line of briars 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags enemies inward, dealing 12 damage and stunning each it catches for 1 second.

fusions.name: Barbed Reprisal
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and the barbs leave them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Burrs Gather
fusions.desc: Every hit you land hooks a burr into the target, up to 4. At 4 they all tear free at once, striking that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per burr (136% at full). Unfed, the burrs fall away.
